workflow.title: Try the chat.
paragraphs: Check the workshop files and send an answer. Review Products.md, work on another file, then open a topic with the documents you saved.

items.title: Add materials
items.text: Bring notes, photos, plans or describe the idea in chat.

items.title: Review
items.text: AI checks the material and asks about what is missing.

items.title: Edit together
items.text: Discuss and edit each document in its own thread. Review it when ready.

items.title: Keep working
items.text: Open a topic and attach the saved documents you want to use.

uploadNote: Interactive walkthrough; changes stay in this page.
